{{Quote|That'll be fourteen credits for the Mantell Mix.|The vendor|<ref name="Battle Scars" />}}
A '''Pantoran vendor''' was present in [[Ord Mantell City]] on [[Ord Mantell]] during [[Clone Force 99]]'s stay on that planet. [[Wrecker]] and [[Omega]] would purchase [[Mantell Mix]] from them as a treat for successfully completing missions. The two did not pay for the Mantell Mix directly with [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]], but rather purchased it on [[Ciddarin Scaleback|Cid's]] tab, eventually amassing a debt of over twenty cartons of the snack.<ref name="Battle Scars" />
